fields.title: Glints record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Glints' own field shape. Upstream field names pass through verbatim, with derived conveniences such as descriptionText and jobUrl added alongside rather than replacing them. Record types: JOB (search or company vacancy card), JOB_DETAIL (full posting), COMPANY, SEARCH_FACETS, SUGGESTION, SKILL, ERROR. Glints adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search term, URL or id this record came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which call produced the row: S1-gql-searchJobsV3, S1-gql-getJobById, S1-gql-getCompanyById, S1-gql-getSimilarJobs, S1-gql-getJobSearchFiltersV2, S1-gql-getJobTitleSuggestions, S1-gql-skills, S2-sitemap, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: JOB, JOB_DETAIL, COMPANY, SEARCH_FACETS, SUGGESTION, SKILL or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: not_found, unparsable_input, login_required, no_results, search_failed, detail_failed, company_failed, similar_failed, filters_failed, suggestions_failed, skills_failed, sitemap_index_failed or run_failed.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker. anon_page_1_only means Glints reported more results than anonymous access can reach, so this query returned only its first page.

title.title: Job title
title.description: Job title as the employer wrote it.

jobUrl.title: Job URL
jobUrl.description: Public glints.com link to the posting.

status.title: Status
status.description: OPEN, CLOSED or another Glints lifecycle state.

type.title: Employment type
type.description: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, INTERNSHIP, CONTRACT, TEMPORARY, FREELANCE, DAILY or PROJECT_BASED.

educationLevel.title: Education level
educationLevel.description: Minimum education the posting asks for.

createdAt.title: Posted at
createdAt.description: When the posting was first created.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the employer last edited the posting.

expiryDate.title: Expires at
expiryDate.description: Detail rows only: when the posting is scheduled to close.

isHot.title: Hot
isHot.description: Glints flags the posting as high-demand.

isActivelyHiring.title: Actively hiring
isActivelyHiring.description: Detail rows only: the employer is currently processing applications.

salaryMin.title: Salary min
salaryMin.description: Lower bound of the headline (BASIC) salary row, flattened out of the salaries array.

salaryMax.title: Salary max
salaryMax.description: Upper bound of the headline salary row. Often null: Glints lets employers publish a floor only.

salaryCurrency.title: Currency
salaryCurrency.description: Currency of the flattened salary figures, for example IDR.

salaryMode.title: Salary period
salaryMode.description: What the salary figure covers: MONTH, YEAR, HOUR, DAY or PROJECT. Compare figures only within one period.

shouldShowSalary.title: Salary published
shouldShowSalary.description: False when the employer chose to hide pay. The salary fields are then empty by the employer's choice, not because the scrape failed.

salaries.title: All salary rows
salaries.description: Glints' full salary array, including allowance rows beyond the headline figure.

salaryEstimate.title: Salary estimate
salaryEstimate.description: Detail rows only: Glints' own estimated range for postings that publish no figure.

companyName.title: Company
companyName.description: Employer's brand name where it has one, otherwise its registered name.

companyUrl.title: Company URL
companyUrl.description: Public glints.com link to the employer profile.

companyLogoUrl.title: Company logo
companyLogoUrl.description: Fetchable image URL built from the storage key Glints returns.

companyIsVerified.title: Verified employer
companyIsVerified.description: True when Glints has verified the employer's identity.

company.title: Company object
company.description: Glints' full nested employer object as returned with the job.

locationName.title: Location
locationName.description: Formatted location name, for example Kab. Badung.

countryCode.title: Country
countryCode.description: Two-letter market code: ID, SG, VN, MY, PH or TW.

location.title: Location object
location.description: Full hierarchical location including coordinates and the district/city/province/country chain.

categoryName.title: Category
categoryName.description: Most specific job category Glints assigned.

categoryPath.title: Category path
categoryPath.description: Full category chain, for example Computer & Software > Data > Data Scientist.

skillNames.title: Skills
skillNames.description: Skill names required or preferred for the role.

skills.title: Skills object
skills.description: Glints' skill array, each entry carrying the skill id and whether it is mandatory.

minYearsOfExperience.title: Min experience (years)
minYearsOfExperience.description: Lower bound of the experience the posting asks for.

maxYearsOfExperience.title: Max experience (years)
maxYearsOfExperience.description: Upper bound of the experience the posting asks for.

descriptionText.title: Description
descriptionText.description: Job description flattened to plain text from Glints' Draft.js document.

descriptionJsonString.title: Description (raw)
descriptionJsonString.description: The original Draft.js document, kept so formatting and links are recoverable.

interviewProcessText.title: Interview process
interviewProcessText.description: Detail rows only: the employer's described hiring steps, as plain text.

benefitTitles.title: Benefits
benefitTitles.description: Detail rows only: benefit names such as Health Insurance or Career Path.

benefits.title: Benefits object
benefits.description: Detail rows only: Glints' full benefits array with codes and descriptions.

companyAddress.title: Workplace address
companyAddress.description: Detail rows only: the street address and point of interest for the workplace.

metadata.title: Schedule
metadata.description: Detail rows only: working days per week, weekend/holiday requirement and shift pattern.

externalApplyURL.title: External apply URL
externalApplyURL.description: For aggregated postings, the third-party board where the application actually goes.

jobSource.title: Job source
jobSource.description: EMPLOYER for postings made on Glints, SOURCED for postings aggregated from other boards.

isHighResponseRate.title: Responsive employer
isHighResponseRate.description: Glints flags this employer as replying quickly to applicants.

creatorResponseRate.title: Response rate
creatorResponseRate.description: Share of applications the hiring side responds to.

creatorResponseTime.title: Response time
creatorResponseTime.description: How quickly the hiring side typically responds.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Which keyword in your input surfaced this row.

similarToJobId.title: Similar to
similarToJobId.description: similarJobs rows: the posting this recommendation was drawn from.

name.title: Company name
name.description: COMPANY rows: the employer's registered name.

jobCount.title: Open vacancies
jobCount.description: COMPANY rows: how many open postings the employer has.

size.title: Company size
size.description: COMPANY rows: headcount band the employer reports.

website.title: Website
website.description: COMPANY rows: the employer's own site.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: COMPANY rows: the employer's one-line pitch.

cultureText.title: Culture
cultureText.description: COMPANY rows: the employer's culture blurb as plain text.

socialMediaSites.title: Social links
socialMediaSites.description: COMPANY rows: decoded social media links.

isVerified.title: Verified
isVerified.description: COMPANY rows: Glints has verified the employer's identity.

verificationTier.title: Verification tier
verificationTier.description: COMPANY rows: how the employer was verified, for example LEGAL_DOCUMENTS.

topCompanyNames.title: Top employers
topCompanyNames.description: SEARCH_FACETS rows: employers with the most postings for this keyword.

topLocationNames.title: Top locations
topLocationNames.description: SEARCH_FACETS rows: districts and cities with the most postings for this keyword. Glints' own `cities` facet is always empty, so this is built from its hierarchical location facet instead.

topJobRoleNames.title: Top roles
topJobRoleNames.description: SEARCH_FACETS rows: job categories this keyword resolves into.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: SEARCH_FACETS rows: salary currencies present in this keyword's results.

hasRemoteJobs.title: Has remote jobs
hasRemoteJobs.description: SEARCH_FACETS rows: whether any posting for this keyword is remote.

suggestion.title: Suggestion
suggestion.description: SUGGESTION rows: the suggested job title or company name.

suggestionType.title: Suggestion type
suggestionType.description: SUGGESTION rows: 'job' for a job title, 'company' for an employer name.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: SUGGESTION rows: the keyword that was completed.

skillId.title: Skill id
skillId.description: SKILL rows: the UUID to pass back as a search skill filter.

skillName.title: Skill name
skillName.description: SKILL rows: the skill as Glints names it.

totalSkills.title: Total skills
totalSkills.description: SKILL rows: how many skills matched the query.
